_about: What this version of Atom Plasma needs. The updater reads the TARGET version's copy (git show <tag>:atom/data/requirements.json) before it updates: a system outside these stays on the version it has. plasma: the oldest and newest Plasma minor versions it runs on. Packages per distro family (arch: Arch, CachyOS, EndeavourOS, Manjaro...): required always; build to compile its parts; features[name] only while that feature is set to on; recommended on a fresh install. aur: true = from the AUR (an AUR helper, paru or yay, in a terminal you watch).
